abstract: We give a key polynomial of degree fourteen whose expansion in Demazure $t$-atoms has a coefficient with a negative term. This computation disproves the conjectured Demazure atom positivity of flagged LLT polynomials and the corresponding stable atom positivity assertion for modified nonsymmetric Macdonald polynomials.
hook: A degree-fourteen polynomial breaks a conjectured positivity rule for LLT and Macdonald polynomials.
hook_turn: breaks a conjectured positivity rule for LLT and Macdonald polynomials.
summary: The author exhibits one explicit polynomial whose expansion in Demazure atoms contains a negative term. That disproves the conjectured atom positivity of flagged LLT polynomials and the matching claim for modified nonsymmetric Macdonald polynomials. The evidence is a single computation, so it kills the conjecture but does not say what the right statement is.
title: Counterexamples to flagged LLT and nonsymmetric Macdonald atom positivity
